annotations.title: Ask a business to call back

description: Ask one business in the VoiceAssistants directory to call the person back. This sends the person's name and phone number to that business. BEFORE calling this tool, say the business's name and the phone number back to the person and get a clear yes; then set `consent` to true. Only some businesses take callback requests — if this one does not, the result says so and gives its phone number instead. Read `spoken` aloud.

consent.description: Must be true: the person has just confirmed, in this conversation, that they want this business to contact them at this number.

name.description: The person's name, as they want the business to address them.

note.description: Optional: what the call is about, in a sentence.

phone.description: The phone number the business should call, with area code.

name: request_callback
title: Ask a business to call back
